# Storage schema

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:generate` (scripts/ci/check-storage-schema.mjs) from the
host-composed owner `CollectionSpec` values (`crates/openhuman-core/src/storage/schema.rs`). Do not edit by hand. -->

Record owners declare collections with `CollectionSpec`; the host composes and prepares
those declarations at boot. Each section lists the specs by the owner namespace in the
collection name, including indexes, expiry fields, and full-text search fields.
Record shapes and migrations stay with their owners.
